---
title: "Thomas System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& ax+sin(y)\\
\dot{y} &=& ay+sin(z)\\
\dot{z} &=& az+sin(x)
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-0.1$ and initial condition $(-1,-2,2)$.
